name: DIVA Laboratories, Ltd.
summary: DIVA Laboratories, Ltd. specializes in the global provision of advanced display technologies. Its comprehensive product lineup caters to critical environments, including specialized endo/surgical displays designed to render both static and dynamic imagery with precision for hybrid and integrated operating theaters, as well as crucial control room applications. Furthermore, DIVA offers a range of color and monochrome monitors tailored for high-accuracy radiology and broader medical imaging purposes. Beyond healthcare, the company develops interactive touch displays and human-machine interface (HMI) solutions, alongside robust medical and industrial enclosures. DIVA also serves original design manufacturers (ODMs) and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) with custom display units, in addition to a broader portfolio of video solutions. Established in 1995, DIVA Laboratories, Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
